definitions.explanation: The quantitative relation between two amounts showing how many times one value contains another.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}の{比率|ひりつ}は3{対|たい}2だ。
{売上|うりあげ}に{占|し}める{輸出|ゆしゅつ}の{比率|ひりつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The proportion of exports in sales is high.

examples.japanese: {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{比率|ひりつ}が{年々|ねんねん}{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: The proportion of elderly people is increasing year by year.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
Literally "comparison rate" — the two characters mean "compare" and "rate".

COMMON TYPES:
・⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧{比率|ひりつ} - male-to-female ratio
・⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧{比率|ひりつ} - population ratio
・⟦{自己資本|じこしほん}→自己資本：noentry⟧{比率|ひりつ} - equity ratio
・⟦{配当|はいとう}→配当：05970_haitou⟧{比率|ひりつ} - dividend ratio
・⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧{比率|ひりつ} - composition ratio

GRAMMAR:
・〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{比率|ひりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (the ratio of ~ is high / low)
・〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{比率|ひりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ / ⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to raise / lower the ratio of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧ - proportion, rate (more common in daily speech)
・⟦{比|ひ}→比：noentry⟧ - ratio (mathematical term)
・⟦{比例|ひれい}→比例：13215_hirei⟧ - proportion (mathematical relationship)
・⟦{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}→百分率：24428_hyakubunritsu⟧ / ⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧ - percentage
